title: agnos.json
description: Single source of truth for an Agnos project: which harnesses are active, how repository rules and docs are composed, and which skills and MCP servers are available.

$schema.description: URL of this JSON schema. Recommended so editors can validate and autocomplete agnos.json.

schemaVersion.description: agnos.json schema version. Must be 1; older/absent values are rejected — re-run `agnos --init`.

harness.description: Active harness ids (e.g. claude-code, codex, gemini-cli).

rules.description: Rules domain. Maps each generated rules artifact to ordered Markdown source files, directories, or glob patterns.

dir.description: Base directory for authored rule sources and destination for bootstrapped rule files (default ".agnos/rules").

fragments.description: Map of generated rules artifact path → ordered source paths. Paths are relative to rules.dir. Each source may be a file, directory, or glob pattern.

skills.description: Skills domain configuration for manually authored local skills and externally sourced skills.

dir.description: Project-relative directory of manually authored skills. These are linked into each agent skills directory and override external skills with the same name.

sources.description: Map of local skill name to a normalized repository or local source request.

references.description: Shared repository references installed from the Agnos global repository store.

dir.description: Project-relative directory for linked reference selections.

sources.description: Map of project-local link name to a repository request.

mcp.description: MCP configuration. Declares server definitions and the env file used to resolve declared server env keys when materializing harness files.

envFile.description: Project-relative env file used to resolve MCP server env keys. Defaults to ".env.local".

servers.description: MCP server declarations, rendered into per-harness MCP config (.mcp.json for Claude Code, .codex/config.toml for Codex).

name.description: Local name for this MCP server.

source.description: Registry reverse-DNS identifier (set when added from the MCP registry; enables version updates).

version.description: Installed registry server version, used to detect updates.

command.description: Executable to run (stdio transport), or the server URL (sse/http transport).

env.description: Env variable names to resolve from mcp.envFile when materializing agent MCP files.

headers.description: HTTP headers for remote (sse/http) transports, e.g. auth tokens.

transport.description: Transport protocol the agent uses to talk to this server.

docs.description: Docs domain configuration. Watches `dir`, compiles an index from the docs' frontmatter metadata. The frontmatter shape (type/title/description/resource/tags/timestamp) is fixed and not configurable.

ignore.description: Glob patterns, relative to docs.dir, excluded from docs indexing.
